required_action: Review the test assets written by Shield against the acceptance criteria and the criteria pack. Verify: every required AC (integration|e2e layer) has at least one test with a valid long-format marker (AC-FRXXXX-YY@v0.4 TRACKS-TRACE); tests assert on public exits (not internal implementation); tests fail with legitimate Red (not ImportError/syntax/fixture); no pseudo-tests or counterexample gaps. Anchor every blocking finding as a discussion thread via trac discuss start and return REVISE; pass only when the test contract is genuinely closed.
